title: indonesias prabowo launches 14 solar power projects 2026 08 25
text:
JAKARTA, Aug 25 (Reuters) - Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto inaugurated 14 solar power ​plant projects on Tuesday with a ‌combined capacity of 5.3 gigawatts, part of the country's goal to add 100 GW of ​new solar capacity by 2029 and ​reduce its dependence on climate-warming fossil fuels.
